1. Call list_all_airports() -> get array of airports (each has id, iataCode). We'll assume response includes at least two items.

2. Extract first_iata and last_iata.

3. Call get_flight_cost(travel_from=first_iata, travel_to=last_iata, travel_date='2024-10-31', travel_class='business').

Return result as JSON.
